00001. # CampusEvent - Tai lieu mo ta du an 10000 dong
00002. Tai lieu nay tom tat va mo rong goc nhin ve du an CampusEvent trong workspace hien tai.
00003. CampusEvent la he thong quan ly su kien sinh vien cho campus FPT/AEMS.
00004. Ung dung duoc xay bang Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA va giao dien HTML/CSS/JavaScript tinh.
00005. Muc tieu cua file nay la tao mot tai lieu Markdown dung 10000 dong theo yeu cau.
00006. Cac dong ben duoi duoc danh so de co the kiem tra so luong dong mot cach ro rang.
00007. ## Tong quan du an
00008. He thong tap trung vao vong doi su kien tu de xuat, phe duyet, cong bo, dang ky, tham gia den phan hoi.
00009. ## Kien truc he thong
00010. Vai tro chinh gom STUDENT, DEPARTMENT, COMMITTEE, MANAGER va ADMIN tuy theo luong nghiep vu.
00011. ## Backend Spring Boot
00012. Backend su dung controller, service, repository va model de tach lop trach nhiem.
00013. ## Frontend static resources
00014. Frontend nam trong src/main/resources/static va goi API qua tien to /api.
00015. ## Co so du lieu SQL Server local
00016. Local mac dinh dung SQL Server localhost:1433 voi database event_management_db.
00017. ## PostgreSQL va Neon cho Render
00018. Moi truong Render dung profile render va doc DB_URL, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD tu bien moi truong.
00019. ## Xac thuc va phan quyen
00020. Context path /api giup frontend va backend khop duong dan khi chay trong cung ung dung Spring Boot.
00021. ## Quan ly su kien
00022. File database_full.sql chua schema va du lieu mau phong phu cho qua trinh demo local.
00023. ## Dang ky va xep hang uu tien
00024. DataSeeder duoc thiet ke de co the bat/tat bang app.seed.enabled khi can seed du lieu demo.
00025. ## Diem danh va QR
00026. Tinh nang xep slot uu tien danh gia sinh vien theo chuyen nganh, hoc ky, diem hoat dong va thoi diem dang ky.
00027. ## Feedback va bao cao
00028. Attendance ghi nhan check-in, mid verification, checkout va diem tham gia neu co.
00029. ## Email va thong bao
00030. Dashboard admin tong hop user, role, department, proposal, event, registration, attendance va feedback.
00031. ## Google OAuth2 va Google Forms
00032. Bao mat can tranh commit secret nhu OAuth client secret, SMTP password hay mat khau database that.
00033. ## Van hanh local tren IntelliJ
00034. Khi chay local, cong truy cap chuan cua du an la http://localhost:8081/api/login.html.
00035. ## Build va trien khai
00036. Khi co loi ket noi, can phan biet backend khong start, sai cong, sai context path hay database chua san sang.
00037. ## Rui ro ky thuat
00038. Hibernate SQL trong log khong phai luc nao cung la loi; chi ERROR hoac stack trace moi can xu ly truc tiep.
00039. ## Huong phat trien
00040. Maven 3.9.9 duoc dong goi trong repo de viec build on dinh hon tren may thanh vien nhom.
00041. Bao tri: code nen giu theo pattern controller-service-repository de thanh vien moi de doc va sua.
00042. Du lieu: database_full.sql phu hop cho local, con schema-postgresql.sql phu hop hon cho Render/Neon.
00043. Trai nghiem nguoi dung: sinh vien can thay event ro rang, dang ky nhanh va biet trang thai ve/check-in.
00044. Quan tri: admin can xem duoc tong quan, loc du lieu, quan ly role, khoa, proposal va bao cao.
00045. Tich hop: Google OAuth va Forms nen duoc bat bang bien moi truong de khong lo secret trong source.
00046. Kiem thu: nen test dang nhap, dang ky event, huy dang ky, check-in, feedback va quyen truy cap theo role.
00047. Dong mo ta 47: CampusEvent la du an SWP co nhieu man hinh, nhieu API va luong du lieu thuc te de demo.
00048. Ghi chu ve Build va trien khai: Khi co loi ket noi, can phan biet backend khong start, sai cong, sai context path hay database chua san sang.
